From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@shoplifter.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 15-min technical triage before demo

Hi Ben,

I signed up on your site this morning (ShopLifter.ai) and our team is evaluating Redwood for replacing an internal serving layer. Before we book a full product demo, could we do a short 15-minute technical triage to verify Latency/throughput assumptions and how KV cache/quantization would fit our flow? We have a couple of sample traces and a small usage CSV attached to this thread.

High level:
- 6 concurrent real-time sessions, typical prompt length ~300 tokens
- Need <200ms p95 for prompt-only requests if possible
- Data retention & VPC options are requirements (we're in fintech)

Availability this week: I have a few windows today between 10:30–12:30 PT or tomorrow morning. 15 minutes is perfect — just want to confirm feasibility before the product demo.

Thanks,
Taylor Nguyen
Head of ML Eng, ShopLifter.ai
(taylor@shoplifter.ai)

Attachment: sample-usage.csv (csv, 14KB)
